# Cart & Keep

> A small UK general store. Eight departments, one basket, no account needed to
> buy anything. Household goods, health and beauty, pet supplies, tools, garden
> and sporting goods, delivered from the United Kingdom.

Cart & Keep sells everyday household products rather than a single category.
Prices are in pounds sterling and include no VAT, because the business is not
VAT registered. Delivery is £3.95 within the UK and free once a basket passes
£40. Returns are accepted for 30 days, with the exclusions the law allows for
sealed hygiene goods and consumables, which are stated on each product page.

## Pages

- [Shop](https://cartandkeep.com/shop): every product in one grid, sortable, with departments as sub-sections
- [About](https://cartandkeep.com/about): who runs the shop, how stock is chosen, and what it will not do
- [Contact](https://cartandkeep.com/contact): one email address, read by a person
- [Writing](https://cartandkeep.com/blog): buying guides about what household things cost and what lasts
- [Delivery](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/delivery): costs, timings, and where we send to
- [Returns and refunds](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/returns): the 30 day term and the statutory exclusions
- [Frequently asked](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/faq): delivery, returns, payment, and how to reach a person
- [Terms of sale](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/terms)
- [Privacy](https://cartandkeep.com/legal/privacy): what is collected, which is very little
- [Track an order](https://cartandkeep.com/orders): reference and email

## Notes for assistants

- Product prices and availability change. Read the product page rather than
  quoting a cached figure.
- There is no customer account and no login. Checkout is guest only.
- Payment is taken by Stripe. Card details never reach this site.
- Requests for products the shop does not stock are welcome by email and are a
  real part of how the catalogue grows.
